descriptions.parakeetCurrentlyOnlySupportsAutomaticLa: Parakeet currently only supports automatic language detection. Manual language selection is not available. Use Whisper if you need to specify a particular language.
descriptions.parakeetTdtV3LanguageLimitations: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 only auto-detects its supported 25 European languages. It does not support Chinese, manual language selection, or translation to English. For Chinese or a specific source language, switch to SenseVoice (Chinese/multilingual) or local Whisper.

descriptions.retranscribeOverwriteWarning: This meeting already has {{count}} transcript segments. Retranscription replaces them with the newly generated result — including segments you corrected by hand — and cannot be undone. The current transcript is backed up into the meeting folder (transcripts-before-retranscription-*.json) before it is overwritten.
descriptions.retranscribeOverwriteShort: Replaces all {{count}} existing segments; the current transcript is backed up first and can be restored in one click.

correction.title: Fix text
correction.hint: First pass is text-only: the rule dictionary plus the meeting's names/terms (seconds, no re-transcription). You can then deepen it with AI. Nothing is written until you apply, and a backup is taken first.
correction.aiHint: Uses the model selected above to flag homophones, term errors and typos per segment. Candidates only; a stronger model works better.
correction.localModelNote: Local models may miss mistakes or suggest unnecessary changes. Review each candidate; another configured model can provide a second check.
correction.modelPickerHint: Proofreading has its own saved model. The list includes models from configured providers. Unavailable providers report an error instead of silently switching.
correction.modelPickerSaved: Text fixes will use {{model}} from now on
correction.modelPickerSaveFailed: Could not save that setting — please try again
correction.noCandidatesHint: The rule/term pass found nothing. Use the button below to let AI take a deeper look.
correction.contextInfo: This meeting has {{persons}} participant(s) / {{terms}} term(s) registered; the rules can only fix words registered here.
